- Market structure: **SIDEWAYS**, borderline. DOWNTURN needs spot more than 20% under the 4-week high (line $68.26) AND VXN at 25 or more. Spot is 19.8% under $85.32, so that test is missed by 0.2 points, while VXN (26.40) passes. RALLY would need about $84.98 (+24.2%) and is far away. A close back under $68.26 would restore DOWNTURN.

- Put-selling context: CAUTIOUS. Premium is rich, RSI is deeply oversold, VIX is under 18 in contango, and the news engine is CLEAR. Against that, VXN is still above 25, spot is 4.7% above the 4-week low and about 5% above the 200DMA, breadth is unmeasured, credit is mixed, and an FOMC decision lands tomorrow. The bounce is one day old, so gap risk stays high. Context only — no strikes, expiries or sizes.
